Undo restores the item and quantity

Failed submit focuses the error summary
Error links focus the related field
Valid local address opens the review
Review explicitly confirms no real order was submitted
Delivery details are absent from local storage
Editing retains the entered address
Corrupt stored cart safely becomes empty
Delivery cannot continue with an empty cart

Increment is disabled at the preview quantity limit
Unknown products have a usable not-found page

Session-only bag survives client navigation when storage is blocked
Unavailable storage is explained to the user
No uncaught errors with blocked localStorage

rawFindings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 36px (2.5vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
rawFindings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

rawFindings.message: The margins differ: 84px on the left, 52px on the right, at 1440px.
rawFindings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
